defs.def: the part of a person that makes them able to be aware of things, to think and to feel 头脑；大脑

ex.s: We brought young children aged 2-4 into our Minds in Development Lab at USC.
ex.t: 我们把2至4岁的幼童带到南加州大学的“心智发展实验室”。

ex.s: Curious Minds Never Feel Contented
ex.t: 好奇的心灵从不感到满足

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 虽然他持有客观现实存在的观念，但他说我们的心智在构建和塑造我们的感知中扮演着必要的角色。

ex.s: Engage your mind.
ex.t: 让你的大脑参与进来。

ex.s: He had an inquiring mind.
ex.t: 他有一颗好探究的心。

ex.s: What did the sight of the violins in that little shop bring to Tara's mind?
ex.t: 看到那家小店里的小提琴， Tara想到了什么？

ex.s: The human mind is bad at noting slow change.
ex.t: 人类大脑不善于察觉缓慢的变化。

ex.s: “Making toys keeps my mind active.
ex.t: “做玩具让我头脑保持活跃。”

ex.s: With that thought in mind, Pruitt 22   a plan and posted it on the community website.
ex.t: 带着这个想法，普鲁伊特22___一个计划并发布在社区网站上。

ex.s: Still, continuing to challenge yourself mentally and keeping your mind busy can only help.
ex.t: 尽管如此，继续在智力上挑战自己、让大脑忙碌起来只会对你有益。

ex.s: Before getting into the car, I thought I had learned the instructor’s orders, so once I started the car, my mind goes blank.
ex.t: 在上车之前，我以为已经记住了教练的指令，可一旦发动车子，我的大脑就一片空白。

ex.s: Argue about the week's hottest topics with the school's sharpest minds!
ex.t: 和全校最机敏的头脑辩论本周最热门的话题！

ex.s: But when we need to keep in mind that what we see on social media is often not the whole truth about a person.
ex.t: 但我们需要记住，我们在社交媒体上看到的往往不是关于一个人的全部真相。

ex.s: C A cheerful mood helps make a creative mind.
ex.t: C 愉快的心情有助于造就创造性的头脑。

ex.s: Our exhibits will feed your mind but what about your body?
ex.t: 我们的展品会喂饱你的头脑，但你的身体呢？

ex.s: It involves doing very slow physical exercises to relax your mind and calm your body.
ex.t: 它涉及做非常缓慢的身体练习，以放松你的头脑，平静你的身体。

ex.s: Last year, Moran worked on a project that arranged Fats Waller’s music for a dance party, “Just to kind of put it back in the mind that Waller is dance music as much as it is concert music,” says Moran.
ex.t: 去年，莫兰参与了一个项目，将法茨·沃勒的音乐改编用于舞会，“就是想让人重新意识到，沃勒的音乐既是舞曲也是音乐会音乐，”莫兰说。

ex.s: It also helps in keeping us calm and relaxes our mind.
ex.t: 它也有助于让我们保持冷静和放松心情。

ex.s: An idea suddenly crossed Cruse's mind.
ex.t: 克鲁斯突然想到一个主意。

ex.s: Although my kindergarten experience feels like a century ago, the lessons I learned will stick in my mind forever.
ex.t: 虽然我的幼儿园经历感觉像是一个世纪前的事，但我学到的教训将永远留在脑海里。

ex.s: When you were trying to figure out what to buy for the environmentalist on your holiday list, fur probably didn’t cross your mind.
ex.t: 当你在为假期名单上的环保主义者挑选礼物时，毛皮可能根本不会出现在你的脑海中。

defs.def: your ability to think and reason; your intelligence; the particular way that sb thinks 思考能力；智慧；思维方式

ex.s: Another study from 2021 tested for “theory of mind” in dogs in a similar way, but the dogs were able to walk round the screen to obtain the treat after witnessing the experimenter’s “unwilling” or “unable” behaviour.
ex.t: 2021年的另一项研究以类似方式测试了狗的“心智理论”，但狗在目睹实验者“不情愿”或“无能为力”的行为后，能够绕到屏幕另一侧去取零食。

ex.s: Considering the stories we tell about ourselves can help us to change our minds for better.
ex.t: 思考我们讲述的关于自己的故事，有助于我们改善自己的想法。

ex.s: The ability to judge others’ intentions is an indicator of possessing “theory of mind” which was once thought to be unique to humans.
ex.t: 判断他人意图的能力是拥有 " 思想理论 " 的一个指标，这种理论曾经被认为是人类特有的。

ex.s: “It’s becoming much rarer to zone out and just let the mind wander, but that’s when we think in ways that broaden our minds.
ex.t: “放空自己、任思绪自由漫游的机会越来越少，但那正是我们以开阔思维的方式思考的时候。

ex.s: Keep your audience in mind.

ex.s: What comes into your mind when you think of British food?
ex.t: 想到英国食物时，你会想到什么？

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 想到讲故事，你脑海中浮现的第一件事，或许是爸妈用各自的嗓音为你讲王子、城堡和怪兽的故事时，你心中形成的幻想世界。

ex.s: This work expanded my mind in ways that are impossible inside the four walls of a classroom.
ex.t: 这份工作在课堂四壁之内不可能实现的方式上拓展了我的心胸。

ex.s: Humor also transports your mind away from your daily troubles.
ex.t: 幽默还能让你的思绪从日常烦恼中转移开来。

ex.s: Another way of setting realistic goals is to analyze your short and long term objectives, keeping in mind your beliefs, values and strengths.
ex.t: 设定现实目标的另一种方法是分析你的短期和长期目标，同时牢记你的信念、价值观和长处。

ex.s: You must keep these points in mind while setting your goals.
ex.t: 设定目标时你必须记住这些要点。

ex.s: Having these personality traits implies the pre-anger state, where anger is in the background of your mind.
ex.t: 今天太平洋科学中心每年为超过130万人提供服务，并将探究式科学教育带给华盛顿州全州的课堂和社区活动。

ex.s: Positive thinking has several beneficial effects on the body and the mind.
ex.t: 积极思维对身体和心灵都有几种有益影响。

ex.s: Develop a questioning mind.
ex.t: 观察周围的未知事物。

ex.s: He left after seven months, physically broken and having lost his mind.
ex.t: 七个月后他离开了身体垮了精神也崩溃了。

ex.s: It opens children's mind.
ex.t: 它值得更多关注。

ex.s: The possibility of entering into and losing such a match should concentrate the minds of computer scientists.
ex.t: 陷入并输掉这样一局棋的可能性，理应让计算机科学家集中注意力。

defs.def: a person who is very intelligent 聪明人；富有才智的人

ex.s: It helps to exercise a person's mind.
ex.t: 它有助于锻炼一个人的心智。

ex.s: made up his mind to runD. lost hope
ex.t: 赢家是一个付出巨大努力的人。

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
ex.t: 大自然似乎向那些观察和等待的人展开。下次你散步时，无论在哪里，都要领略所有的景色、声音和感觉。带着这种心态闲逛，你会为生活打开一个新的维度。

ex.s: Opportunity favors those with a curious mind．
ex.t: C．机会青睐那些有好奇心的人。

ex.s: Opportunity awaits those with a cautious mind．
ex.t: D．机会等待有谨慎之心的人。

ex.s: It was all about the battle against my own body and mind.
ex.t: 那全是关于和我自己身体与心智的战斗。

defs.def: your thoughts, interest, etc. 心思

ex.s: Such thoughts filled her mind.
ex.t: 这样的想法充满了她的脑海。

ex.s: I read both definitions over again, trying to figure it out, but Miss Chevalier must have read my mind.
ex.t: 我把两个释义又读了一遍，试图弄明白，但谢瓦利埃小姐一定看穿了我的心思。

ex.s: Your eyes were engaged, but your mind was not.
ex.t: 你的眼睛在看，但你的心不在焉。

ex.t: 性别观念根植于人们的思想中。

defs.def: your ability to remember things 记忆力

ex.s: open our mind to new things and ideas
ex.t: C．对我们的思想接纳新事物和新观念

defs.def: to remember sb/sth 想起；记起

ex.s: Inglis said phone boxes called to mind an age when things were built to last.
ex.t: 英格利斯说，电话亭让人想起一个东西都做得经久耐用的时代。

ex.s: Feeling desperate, Eva started using a mind trick on herself.
ex.t: 感到绝望的伊娃开始对自己使用心理技巧。

ex.s: “Our classrooms are built with kids in mind.
ex.t: "我们的教室是为孩子们设计的。

ex.s: Dogs also have “theory of mind”.
ex.t: 狗也具有“心智理论”。

ex.s: 一I haven’t made up my mind whether I’ll sign the contract with this company.
ex.t: —我还没决定是否要与这家公司签合同。

ex.s: Keep their audience in mind.
ex.t: 心中有观众。

ex.s: With these main reasons in mind, we can evaluate our level of anger throughout the day and prevent cases of outbursts by comprehending the reasons for our feelings.
ex.t: 咖啡馆位于1号楼楼上，每天营业直到太平洋科学中心关门前一小时。

ex.s: make up his mind to be a painter
ex.t: 下定决心要当一名画家

ex.s: Community isn’t so much a place as it is a state of mind.
ex.t: 社区与其说是一个地方，不如说是一种心态。

defs.def: to remind you of sb/sth 使想起；使记起

ex.s: What did you have in mind, Miss Ream?
ex.t: 你有什么想法，里姆小姐？

ex.s: What do you have in mind?
ex.t: 你心里有什么想法？

defs.def: 想去做某事，可能会做某事（但不确定）

ex.s: Just keep an open mind and take part in as much as possible.
ex.t: 只要保持开放的心态，尽可能地多参与。

defs.def: （表明有心做某事，但未必采取行动）

ex.s: She made up her mind to be a polite girl.
ex.t: 她下定决心要做一个有礼貌的女孩。

defs.def: to be upset, annoyed or worried by sth 尤用于疑问句或否定句，不用于被动句
（请求允许或客气地请人做事）介意

ex.s: “I don’t really mind it,” Emil Norby told Modern Farmer magazine.
ex.t: “我并不真的介意，”埃米尔·诺比告诉《现代农民》杂志。

defs.def: to not care or not be concerned about sth 不关心；不在意；不考虑

ex.s: Consider and keep in mind why you want to make a change, including how the change reflects your values.
ex.t: 考虑并记住你为什么要做出改变，包括这种改变如何反映你的价值观。

defs.def: to be willing to do sth 愿意做；乐意做

ex.s: This effort is not just a（n）   33   at being community minded—it's also a    34   measure.
ex.t: 这项努力不仅是一种具有社区意识的___33___，也是一项___34___措施。

ex.s: In the course of a couple of hours, he   53   me just how much one can gain from   54   with an open mind, and a willingness to   55   with locals from all walks of life.
ex.t: 在几个小时的过程中，他让我___53___认识到，一个人以开放的心态___54___，并愿意与各行各业的当地人___55___，能获得多少收获。

ex.s: Did they follow those least willing to change their minds?
ex.t: 他们是否追随那些最不愿意改变主意的人？

defs.def: 当心；注意
to pay attention to what sb says, and obey them 听从
to take care of sb/sth 关心，照看（人或物）
（想要确保对方不反对，或客气地请人做事）你不会在意吧，你若不介意的话

ex.s: Will the golden word “success” form in their minds when they review our achievements?
ex.t: 当他们回顾我们的成就时，『成功』这个金光闪闪的词会在他们脑海中浮现吗？

ex.s: “We can’t seem to make up our minds whether we want a modern city or a traditional one.
ex.t: 我们似乎拿不定主意，到底是想要一座现代城市还是传统城市。

ex.s: So she desired to get round the warning, "Why can't I make a healthy candy that's good for my teeth so that my parents can't say no to it?" With that in mind, Moore asked her dad if she could start her own candy company.
ex.t: 于是她渴望避开这个警告：'为什么我不能做一种对牙齿有益的健康糖果，这样我父母就不会拒绝它呢？'带着这个想法，Moore 问她父亲她是否能创办自己的糖果公司。

ex.s: She never minded the alarm clock sounding at 4 am or questioned my expenses on running.
ex.t: 她从不介意凌晨4点的闹钟响起，也不质疑我在跑步上的开销。

ex.s: “Listen, if you don't mind, I'd like to come to the school and read with you. ”he said.
ex.t: “听着，如果你不介意的话，我想来学校和你一起读书。”他说。

ex.s: I don’t mind at allB.

ex.s: This adaptability ensures that complex historical concepts become accessible and engaging for young minds.
ex.t: 这种适应性确保复杂的历史概念能够被年轻的心灵所理解和喜爱。

ex.s: This year, with an open mind and new knowledge in mind, I walked into another group interview while telling myself I was that cool senior.
ex.t: 今年，带着开放的心态和新知，我走进另一次小组面试，告诉自己我就是那个从容的高年级生。

（表示委婉拒绝）
（用于安慰）没关系
used to suggest that sth is not important （表示并不重要）没关系，无所谓

ex.s: “People get in their minds an idea of what teachers do, but that’s not really what it is here.”
ex.t: “人们心里对老师的工作有一种固有印象，但这里其实并不是那样。”
